title: Minty Smashed Green Pea and Egg Toasts
intro: Cool mint and a creamy yogurt-pea mash top crisp whole-grain toast in this savory, satisfying breakfast.

ingredients.name: frozen green peas
ingredients.canonical_name: Peas, green, frozen, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

instructions: Boil water in a small pot over high heat. Add the peas, cook for 2 to 3 minutes until tender, and drain well.
Transfer the warm peas to a bowl. Add the yogurt, lemon juice, mint, and garlic powder, mashing with a fork until chunky but spreadable.
Whisk the whole eggs and egg whites together in a small bowl until fully blended.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Pour in the eggs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring gently until soft curds form.
Spread the minted pea mash evenly over the warm toasts. Top with the scrambled eggs and crumbled feta.
Serve immediately alongside the sliced fresh strawberries.
variation: Swap the fresh mint for fresh dill or chopped basil.
conservation: Best enjoyed right away; assembled toasts do not keep.
